rules.statement: A decision by a bench of five or more Judges convened by the Chief Justice under Section 51 (1) of the Courts Ordinance carries in my opinion, the same authority as a decision of a Full Bench.
rules.supporting_quote: "I agree generally with the observations of My Lord the Chief Justice subject however to the following : i A decision by a bench of five or more Judges convened by the Chief Justice under Section 51 (1) of the Courts Ordinance carries in my opinion, the same authority as a decision of a Full Bench."
